hard_limits.name: No personal detail before the phone match
hard_limits.rule: No recipient name, address or proof of delivery reaches the customer for a parcel whose phone has not matched (S4).

hard_limits.name: No compensation promised
hard_limits.rule: No reply promises compensation, a refund or a payment (C16, S3).

hard_limits.name: No handover to the wrong person
hard_limits.rule: Every handover goes to the person the Answer Key names for that case (S20a).

hard_limits.name: No handover the case does not need
hard_limits.rule: No handover beyond the ones the case expects (S9, S25).

hard_limits.name: No near match guessed
hard_limits.rule: Every tracking number in a tool call is one the customer gave (S5).
